# Feature Spec: Admin Dashboard & Participant Management

> **Reverse-engineered from:** `AdminService.cs`, `IAdminService.cs`, `AdminController.cs`
> **Generated by:** Reverse prompting — analyzing implementation to describe what the system does in business terms.

---

## Overview

The Admin module provides program administrators with the tools to monitor the AI Trail program, review participant evidence submissions, and manage participant progression through badge levels (Greenhorn → Wayfinder → TrailGuide → Pioneer).

---

## Feature 1: Participant Search & Lookup

### Description
Admins can view all enrolled participants and search/filter by name, email, or team.

### Business Rules
| # | Rule |
|---|------|
| 1.1 | All participants are returned when no search term is provided. |
| 1.2 | Search matches against **display name**, **email**, or **team** fields. |
| 1.3 | Search is **case-insensitive**. |
| 1.4 | An admin can retrieve a single participant's full profile by user ID. |

### Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** an admin requests all participants with no search filter, **when** the request completes, **then** every enrolled participant is returned.
- **Given** an admin searches for "alice", **when** a participant has display name "Alice Smith", **then** that participant is included in results.
- **Given** an admin searches for "Team B", **when** a participant belongs to that team, **then** that participant is included in results.
- **Given** an admin searches for a term matching no participants, **when** the request completes, **then** an empty list is returned.

---

## Feature 2: Evidence Review Queue

### Description
Admins can view all pending level submissions awaiting review and drill into evidence for a specific user and level.

### Business Rules
| # | Rule |
|---|------|
| 2.1 | Pending submissions are level submissions where `IsSubmitted = true` and `IsApproved = false`. |
| 2.2 | Admins can retrieve all evidence submissions for a specific user at a specific badge level. |

### Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** two participants have submitted their Greenhorn level for review, **when** the admin views pending submissions, **then** both level submissions are listed.
- **Given** an admin selects a participant, **when** they drill into a specific level, **then** all evidence submissions for that user/level are returned.

---

## Feature 3: Approve Evidence

### Description
An admin can approve an individual evidence submission for a specific criterion.

### Business Rules
| # | Rule |
|---|------|
| 3.1 | The evidence submission must exist; otherwise an error is raised. |
| 3.2 | On approval, the evidence status is set to **Approved**. |
| 3.3 | The review timestamp (`ReviewedAt`) and reviewing admin (`ReviewedBy`) are recorded. |
| 3.4 | Once approved, the participant **cannot edit** that criterion's evidence. |

### Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a submitted evidence record exists, **when** an admin approves it, **then** the status changes to Approved and the reviewer info is recorded.
- **Given** a non-existent evidence record, **when** an admin attempts approval, **then** an `InvalidOperationException` is raised with message "Evidence submission not found."

---

## Feature 4: Reject Evidence

### Description
An admin can reject an evidence submission, providing mandatory feedback that explains what needs to change.

### Business Rules
| # | Rule |
|---|------|
| 4.1 | **Feedback is required.** Empty, null, or whitespace-only feedback causes an `ArgumentException`. |
| 4.2 | The evidence submission must exist; otherwise an error is raised. |
| 4.3 | On rejection, the status is set to **Rejected**, and the admin feedback, reviewer ID, and timestamp are saved. |
| 4.4 | A rejected criterion **can** be re-edited by the participant (unlike approved or submitted criteria). |

### Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** an admin rejects evidence with feedback "Missing branch name", **when** the operation completes, **then** the status is Rejected and `AdminFeedback` is "Missing branch name".
- **Given** an admin attempts to reject evidence with an empty string, **when** the call is made, **then** an `ArgumentException` is thrown with "Feedback is required".
- **Given** an admin attempts to reject evidence with whitespace-only feedback, **when** the call is made, **then** an `ArgumentException` is thrown.

---

## Feature 5: Level Advancement

### Description
After all criteria for a participant's current level are approved, an admin can advance the participant to the next badge level.

### Business Rules
| # | Rule |
|---|------|
| 5.1 | The participant must exist; otherwise an error is raised. |
| 5.2 | **Pioneer is the highest level** — advancement from Pioneer is not allowed. |
| 5.3 | **Every exit criterion** for the current level must have an approved evidence submission. If any criterion is missing or not yet approved, advancement is blocked. |
| 5.4 | On advancement, the level submission is marked as approved with timestamp and approver. |
| 5.5 | The participant's `CurrentLevel` is incremented to the next `BadgeLevel` enum value. |
| 5.6 | The `LastAdvancementAt` timestamp is set to `DateTime.UtcNow`. |
| 5.7 | Historical evidence for prior levels is **retained** (not deleted). |

### Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** all Greenhorn criteria are approved, **when** the admin advances the participant, **then** their level becomes Wayfinder and `LastAdvancementAt` is set.
- **Given** only 1 of 3 criteria is approved, **when** the admin attempts advancement, **then** an error is thrown specifying the unapproved criterion.
- **Given** a participant is already at Pioneer level, **when** the admin attempts advancement, **then** an error is thrown with "Pioneer is the highest level."
- **Given** a participant is advanced from Greenhorn to Wayfinder, **when** their Greenhorn evidence is queried, **then** all evidence records still exist with Approved status.

## Feature 6: Program Statistics

### Description
Admins can view aggregate statistics about the AI Trail program.

### Business Rules
| # | Rule |
|---|------|
| 6.1 | `TotalParticipants` = count of all enrolled participants. |
| 6.2 | `LevelCounts` = breakdown by each badge level (Greenhorn, Wayfinder, TrailGuide, Pioneer). |
| 6.3 | `WayfinderPercentage` = percentage of participants at Wayfinder level **or above**, rounded to 1 decimal place. |
| 6.4 | If there are zero participants, `WayfinderPercentage` is 0 (no division by zero). |
| 6.5 | `PendingReviews` = count of level submissions awaiting admin review. |

### Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** 5 participants (1 Greenhorn, 2 Wayfinder, 1 TrailGuide, 1 Pioneer), **when** stats are queried, **then** `WayfinderPercentage` = 80.0 and level counts are correct.
- **Given** zero participants, **when** stats are queried, **then** all values are 0.

## Feature 7: Team Progress Dashboard

### Description
Admins can view progress broken down by team, including per-member detail and stalled-participant detection.

### Business Rules
| # | Rule |
|---|------|
| 7.1 | Participants are **grouped by team name**. Participants with no team are grouped under "Unassigned". |
| 7.2 | Teams are returned in **alphabetical order**. |
| 7.3 | Each team includes `MemberCount`, `LevelCounts` breakdown, and a list of `Members`. |
| 7.4 | Each member shows: `UserId`, `DisplayName`, `CurrentLevel`, `DaysAtCurrentLevel`, `LastEvidenceDate`, and `IsStalled`. |
| 7.5 | `DaysAtCurrentLevel` is calculated from `LastAdvancementAt` (or `CreatedAt` if never advanced). |
| 7.6 | `LastEvidenceDate` is the most recent `SubmittedAt` date across all evidence for the user's current level. |
| 7.7 | A participant is **stalled** if: (a) they have been at their current level for more than **14 days**, AND (b) they have no evidence submitted in the last 14 days. |
| 7.8 | A recently created participant (< 14 days) is **not** considered stalled, even with no evidence. |
| 7.9 | A participant with recent evidence (< 14 days ago) is **not** stalled, even if at the same level for > 14 days. |

### Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** participants on teams "Platform" and "Payments", **when** team progress is queried, **then** two team groups are returned with correct member counts and level breakdowns.
- **Given** a participant created 30 days ago with no evidence, **when** team progress is queried, **then** they are marked as stalled.
- **Given** a participant created 30 days ago with evidence submitted 2 days ago, **when** team progress is queried, **then** they are **not** marked as stalled.
- **Given** a participant created today with no evidence, **when** team progress is queried, **then** they are **not** marked as stalled.

## Assumptions & Uncertainties

| # | Item | Notes |
|---|------|-------|
| A1 | The stalled threshold (14 days) is hardcoded. | There is no configuration mechanism to adjust this per-team or globally. |
| A2 | Level advancement is one-directional. | There is no mechanism to demote a participant or reset their level. |
| A3 | Evidence approval is per-criterion, but advancement checks all criteria. | Partial approval is allowed; advancement is an explicit admin action, not automatic. |
| A4 | The search feature is a simple `Contains` match. | No fuzzy matching, ranking, or pagination is implemented. |
| A5 | Team names come from participant data. | There is no separate team entity or team management feature. |
